title: Golden Line: Toward What Matters
description:
A directional instrument for recording long-horizon aspirations and observable movement toward them. It returns one of four directional readings per aspiration against a versioned registry and deliberately computes no aggregate: there is no virtue score, and NOT_OBSERVED means no valid entry was admitted rather than that nobody looked.

Subtitle: An Aspirational Thread for Long-Horizon Work

Code is MIT licensed; prose and figures are CC BY 4.0. See LICENSE in the repository.
notes: Current membership belongs to https://github.com/docxology/line_set; the founding four are historical origin. Copper resource quantities are not aspiration priorities or proof of fair allocation; Iron recorded recovery target comparisons are not aspirational progress or promises of future recovery. Violet, Copper, and Iron sources are access-controlled; membership is not access. Known sibling DOIs are retained historical identities. Previously verified source archive: 0.6.2, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.24069424; identifies that source ZIP only, not a standalone manuscript. DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22833506 identifies historical edition 0.4.1. This metadata cites later source through its repository until that exact edition/object is independently verified.
